blocks.text: Lakhmir returns claiming that the family has been released, but the Guru sees through the lie and rebukes him for hiding the truth beneath outward civility. (17–19)
Refusing to settle among the deceitful, the Guru leaves without taking payment or gifts, and the next movement begins toward the birar country and the scrublands beyond. (20; 22.1)
This turn is driven explicitly by Lakhmir's betrayal, which closes one refuge and forces the next stage of wandering through harsher territory. (overall)
